<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ms">
<head>
  <base target="_top">
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Sistem Agihan Tugas Guru</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:opsz,wght,FILL,GRAD@24,400,0..1,0&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
/* Sistem Agihan Tugas Guru - Style.html
 * Gaya "Moden berwarna": lapang, kad lembut, palet pastel, ikon besar.
 * Vanilla CSS (tiada Tailwind CDN). Nama kelas dikekalkan untuk JS_App/JS_Modul.
 */
:root {
  --primary: #1E3A5F;
  --primary-dark: #15294A;
  --primary-light: #EAF0F8;
  --accent: #0F766E;
  --accent-light: #DDF5F1;
  --success: #15803D;
  --warning: #B45309;
  --danger: #C02626;
  --bg: #F4F6FB;
  --surface: #FFFFFF;
  --surface-2: #F7F9FC;
  --border: #E7EBF2;
  --border-input: #D3DAE5;
  --text: #16213A;
  --text-2: #55627A;
  --text-3: #8592A8;
  --th-bg: #F7F9FC;
  /* Status beban (tidak berubah maknanya) */
  --terbeban: #C02626; --terbeban-bg: #FFE9E9;
  --seimbang: #15803D; --seimbang-bg: #E3F7EA;
  --kurang: #B45309;  --kurang-bg: #FFF2DC;
  --warn-border: #FBE1B0;
  /* Palet pastel kategori */
  --biru: #3B5BDB; --biru-bg: #EEF3FF;
  --hijau: #12805C; --hijau-bg: #E6F7EF;
  --kuning: #B45309; --kuning-bg: #FFF4DE;
  --jambu: #C2255C; --jambu-bg: #FFEEF2;
  --ungu: #6741D9; --ungu-bg: #F2EEFF;
  --teal: #0F766E; --teal-bg: #E2F6F3;
  --info-bg: #EEF3FF; --info-border: #D5E0FF; --info: #2F4BB8;
  --shadow-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(22,33,58,.04), 0 1px 3px rgba(22,33,58,.06);
  --shadow-2: 0 6px 16px -4px rgba(22,33,58,.10), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(22,33,58,.06);
  --shadow-3: 0 24px 48px -12px rgba(22,33,58,.22);
  --r-card: 16px;
  --r-input: 10px;
  --sidebar-w: 272px;
  --topbar-h: 64px;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
body {
  font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; color: var(--text); background: var(--bg);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
.num, .tnum, table td, .kpi-nilai { font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1, "cv05" 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.mono { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; }
a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; }
a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
h1, h2, h3, h4 { margin: 0; color: var(--text); }
h1 { font-size: 26px; line-height: 34px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
h2 { font-size: 19px; line-height: 27px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
h3 { font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; }
p { margin: 0; }
.muted { color: var(--text-2); }
.kecil { font-size: 13px; line-height: 19px; }
.sangat-kecil { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; }
.tebal { font-weight: 600; }
.merah { color: var(--danger); } .hijau { color: var(--success); } .ambar { color: var(--warning); }
.kanan { text-align: right; } .tengah { text-align: center; }
.sembunyi { display: none !important; }
.ms { font-family: 'Material Symbols Outlined'; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; direction: ltr;
  -webkit-font-feature-settings: 'liga'; font-feature-settings: 'liga'; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 0, 'wght' 400, 'GRAD' 0, 'opsz' 24; vertical-align: middle; flex-shrink: 0; }
.ms.isi { font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1, 'wght' 400, 'GRAD' 0, 'opsz' 24; }
.ms.sm { font-size: 17px; } .ms.lg { font-size: 28px; }

/* ---------- Susun atur ---------- */
.shell { display: flex; min-height: 100vh; }
.sidebar {
  width: var(--sidebar-w); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1E3A5F 0%, #22426B 100%); color: #fff;
  position: fixed; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; z-index: 40;
  transition: width .2s ease;
}
.sidebar .jenama { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 16px; min-height: 76px; }
.sidebar .jenama .logo-kotak { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--primary);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.sidebar .jenama .logo-kotak img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; }
/* Logo sekolah dipaparkan sendiri, tanpa kotak latar */
.sidebar .jenama .logo-kotak.ada-logo { background: transparent; border-radius: 0; width: 44px; height: 44px; }
.sidebar .jenama .teks { overflow: hidden; }
.sidebar .jenama .teks b { display: block; font-size: 14px; line-height: 18px; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; }
.sidebar .jenama .teks span { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.65); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.nav { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; }
.nav li a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
  font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; margin-bottom: 4px; white-space: nowrap; }
.nav li a .ms { font-size: 22px; }
.nav li a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); color: #fff; }
.nav li a.aktif { background: #fff; color: var(--primary); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.12); }
.nav .pemisah { height: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); margin: 12px 6px; }
.sidebar .kaki { padding: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.sidebar .kaki .versi { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); padding: 0 4px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.sidebar .kaki .versi .hak-cipta { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.38); }
.sidebar .kaki .btn-ikon { color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); }
.sidebar .kaki .btn-ikon:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-color: transparent; color: #fff; }
body.sidebar-kecil .sidebar .kaki { justify-content: center; }
.kolum-utama { flex: 1; margin-left: var(--sidebar-w); min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: margin-left .2s ease; }
body.sidebar-kecil .sidebar { width: 76px; }
body.sidebar-kecil .sidebar .jenama { justify-content: center; padding: 18px 0; }
body.sidebar-kecil .sidebar .jenama .teks, body.sidebar-kecil .nav li a span.label, body.sidebar-kecil .sidebar .kaki .versi { display: none; }
body.sidebar-kecil .kolum-utama { margin-left: 76px; }
body.sidebar-kecil .nav li a { justify-content: center; padding: 11px 0; }

.topbar { height: var(--topbar-h); background: rgba(244,246,251,.85); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); display: flex; align-items: center;
  gap: 12px; padding: 0 32px; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 30; }
.topbar .nama-sekolah { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 600; min-width: 0; color: var(--text-2); }
.topbar .nama-sekolah span.t { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.topbar .ruang { flex: 1; }
.topbar .pengguna { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #fff; padding: 4px 12px 4px 4px; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); }
.topbar select.input { border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); }
.avatar { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--primary); color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center;
  justify-content: center; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.avatar.kecil { width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 12px; background: var(--biru-bg); color: var(--biru); }
.pengguna .info b { display: block; font-size: 13px; line-height: 16px; }
.pengguna .info span { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-2); }
.peranan { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--biru-bg); color: var(--biru);
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }
.peranan.PK { background: var(--teal-bg); color: var(--teal); }
.peranan.GURU { background: var(--ungu-bg); color: var(--ungu); }
.btn-ikon { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--text-2);
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; }
.btn-ikon:hover { background: #fff; border-color: var(--border); }
.kandungan { padding: 8px 32px 100px; max-width: 1360px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; }
.kepala-halaman { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 8px 0 24px; }
.kepala-halaman .kiri { min-width: 0; }
.kepala-halaman .crumb { display: none; }
.kepala-halaman .sub { color: var(--text-2); margin-top: 4px; }
.kepala-halaman .tindakan { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.grid { display: grid; gap: 20px; }
.g-2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); }
.g-3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); }
.g-4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr)); }
.g-6 { grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0,1fr)); }
.g-2-1 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,3fr) minmax(0,2fr); }
.baris { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.baris.antara { justify-content: space-between; }
.tindan > * + * { margin-top: 20px; }
.tindan-sm > * + * { margin-top: 8px; }
.mt-8 { margin-top: 8px; } .mt-16 { margin-top: 16px; } .mt-24 { margin-top: 24px; } .mb-16 { margin-bottom: 16px; }
.flex-1 { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

/* ---------- Kad ---------- */
.kad { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--r-card); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); }
.kad-pad { padding: 24px; }
.kad-kepala { padding: 20px 24px 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.kad-kepala .sub { color: var(--text-2); font-size: 13px; }
.kad-badan { padding: 16px 24px 24px; }
.kad-kaki { padding: 14px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* KPI: bulatan ikon berwarna + nombor besar */
.kpi { padding: 20px; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 0; }
.kpi .ikon-bulat { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
.kpi .ikon-bulat .ms { font-size: 26px; }
.kpi .label { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-2); font-weight: 500; }
.kpi .kpi-nilai { font-size: 30px; line-height: 36px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.kpi .nota { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-3); }
.kpi.klik { cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .kpi.klik:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-2); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.warna-biru .ikon-bulat { background: var(--biru-bg); color: var(--biru); }
.warna-hijau .ikon-bulat { background: var(--hijau-bg); color: var(--hijau); }
.warna-kuning .ikon-bulat { background: var(--kuning-bg); color: var(--kuning); }
.warna-jambu .ikon-bulat { background: var(--jambu-bg); color: var(--jambu); }
.warna-ungu .ikon-bulat { background: var(--ungu-bg); color: var(--ungu); }
.warna-teal .ikon-bulat { background: var(--teal-bg); color: var(--teal); }
/* Keserasian kelas lama */
.kpi.merah .kpi-nilai { color: var(--danger); } .kpi.ambar .kpi-nilai { color: var(--warning); } .kpi.hijau .kpi-nilai { color: var(--success); }

/* Salam & senarai perhatian */
.salam { background: linear-gradient(120deg, #1E3A5F 0%, #2C5A8C 60%, #0F766E 100%); color: #fff; border-radius: 20px; padding: 26px 28px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 24px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-2); }
.salam h1 { color: #fff; }
.salam p { color: rgba(255,255,255,.8); margin-top: 4px; }
.salam .btn { background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-color: transparent; color: #fff; }
.salam .btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.24); }
.senarai-ringkas { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.senarai-ringkas li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); cursor: pointer; }
.senarai-ringkas li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.senarai-ringkas li:hover .nama { color: var(--primary); text-decoration: underline; }
.senarai-ringkas .nama { font-weight: 500; }
.tajuk-kecil { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-2); margin: 14px 0 2px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }

/* ---------- Butang & borang ---------- */
.btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--r-input);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
  text-decoration: none; transition: background .15s, box-shadow .15s; }
.btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2); text-decoration: none; }
.btn:focus-visible, .input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.btn.utama { background: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px -2px rgba(30,58,95,.35); }
.btn.utama:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); }
.btn.aksen { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
.btn.bahaya { background: var(--danger); border-color: var(--danger); color: #fff; }
.btn.bahaya-lembut { background: var(--terbeban-bg); border-color: transparent; color: var(--danger); }
.btn.hantu { border-color: transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--text-2); }
.btn.hantu:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
.btn.sm { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 9px; }
.btn[disabled] { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }
.input, select.input, textarea.input { height: 42px; width: 100%; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border-input); border-radius: var(--r-input);
  background: #fff; font: inherit; color: var(--text); }
textarea.input { height: auto; min-height: 90px; padding: 10px 14px; resize: vertical; }
select.input { padding-right: 30px; }
.input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(30,58,95,.12); }
.input[readonly] { background: var(--bg, #F3F5F9); color: var(--text-muted, #56647C); cursor: not-allowed; }
.input[readonly]:focus { border-color: inherit; box-shadow: none; }
.input.sm { height: 36px; font-size: 14px; }
.medan { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.medan label, .label-medan { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text); }
.medan .bantuan { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-3); }
.carian { position: relative; }
.carian .ms { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--text-3); }
.carian .input { padding-left: 40px; }
.togol { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
.togol input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; }
.togol .trek { width: 40px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #CDD5E1; position: relative; transition: background .15s; flex-shrink: 0; }
.togol .trek::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 3px; top: 3px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; transition: transform .15s; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); }
.togol input:checked + .trek { background: var(--accent); }
.togol input:checked + .trek::after { transform: translateX(16px); }
.togol input:focus-visible + .trek { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
input[type=checkbox].kotak { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: var(--primary); cursor: pointer; }
input[type=range] { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.tapis-baris { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-end; }
.tapis-baris .medan { min-width: 150px; }
.tapis-baris select.input { max-width: 240px; }

.seg { display: inline-flex; background: #EBEFF6; border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px; gap: 2px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.seg button { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 9px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-2); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500; }
.seg button.aktif { background: #fff; color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); }
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 20px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }
.tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.tabs button { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 9px 16px; font: inherit; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-2); cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; }
.tabs button:hover { background: #fff; }
.tabs button.aktif { color: #fff; background: var(--primary); }

/* ---------- Jadual ---------- */
.jadual-bungkus { overflow: auto; max-height: 70vh; }
.jadual-bungkus.penuh { max-height: none; }
table.jadual { width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; }
.jadual th { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2; background: #fff; color: var(--text-3); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
  text-align: left; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); white-space: nowrap; }
.jadual td { padding: 14px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #F0F3F8; vertical-align: middle; }
.jadual tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.jadual tbody tr:hover td { background: #FAFBFE; }
.jadual tr.klik { cursor: pointer; }
.jadual tr.dipilih td { background: var(--biru-bg) !important; }
.jadual tr.amaran-baris td { background: #FFFAF0; }
.jadual td.num, .jadual th.num { text-align: right; }
.jadual .nama-sel { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-width: 200px; }
.jadual .nama-sel b { font-weight: 500; display: block; }
.halaman-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.halaman-nav button { min-width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-2); }
.halaman-nav button:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
.halaman-nav button.aktif { background: var(--primary); color: #fff; }
.halaman-nav button[disabled] { opacity: .35; cursor: default; }

/* ---------- Pil & lencana ---------- */
.pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 18px; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pill.terbeban { background: var(--terbeban-bg); color: var(--terbeban); }
.pill.seimbang { background: var(--seimbang-bg); color: var(--seimbang); }
.pill.kurang { background: var(--kurang-bg); color: var(--kurang); }
.pill.neutral { background: #EFF2F7; color: var(--text-2); }
.pill.info { background: var(--biru-bg); color: var(--biru); }
.pill .label-zon { font-weight: 500; opacity: .9; }
/* Amaran dalam bahasa biasa: titik berwarna + teks */
.amaran { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-2); white-space: nowrap; cursor: help; margin-right: 10px; }
.amaran::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--warning); flex-shrink: 0; }
.amaran.merah::before { background: var(--danger); }
.amaran.ungu::before { background: var(--ungu); }
.wbadge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--kuning-bg);
  color: var(--warning); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 18px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: help; }
.wbadge.merah { background: var(--terbeban-bg); color: var(--danger); }
.cip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500;
  background: #EFF2F7; color: var(--text-2); white-space: nowrap; line-height: 18px; }
.cip.UTAMA { background: var(--ungu-bg); color: var(--ungu); }
.cip.SOKONGAN { background: var(--biru-bg); color: var(--biru); }
.cip.SAMPINGAN { background: #EFF2F7; color: var(--text-2); }
.cip.tempoh { background: var(--teal-bg); color: var(--teal); }
.cip.wajib { background: var(--kuning-bg); color: var(--warning); }
.cip.tag { background: var(--jambu-bg); color: var(--jambu); }
.cip.hijau { background: var(--seimbang-bg); color: var(--success); }
.cip.merah { background: var(--terbeban-bg); color: var(--danger); }
.cip.ambar { background: var(--kuning-bg); color: var(--warning); }
.cip.biru { background: var(--biru-bg); color: var(--biru); }
.cip.kelabu { background: #EFF2F7; color: var(--text-2); }
.gred { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: #EFF2F7; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-2); }

/* ---------- Makluman ---------- */
.makluman { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 14px; border: 0; background: var(--info-bg); color: #263E8F; align-items: flex-start; }
.makluman.ambar { background: var(--kuning-bg); color: #7A3D07; }
.makluman.merah { background: var(--terbeban-bg); color: #8A1C1C; }
.makluman.hijau { background: var(--hijau-bg); color: #0E5A3F; }
.makluman .ms { margin-top: 1px; }
.makluman b { font-weight: 600; }
.kosong { text-align: center; padding: 48px 20px; color: var(--text-2); }
.kosong .ms { font-size: 44px; color: #A9B4C6; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.kosong h3 { margin-bottom: 4px; }

/* ---------- Carta ---------- */
.carta-svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.carta-svg text { font-family: inherit; fill: var(--text-3); font-size: 11px; }
.carta-svg .grid-line { stroke: #EEF1F6; stroke-width: 1; }
.carta-svg .paksi { stroke: #D3DAE5; stroke-width: 1; }
.carta-svg rect.bar:hover, .carta-svg path.bar:hover { opacity: .85; }
.legenda { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-2); }
.legenda span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.legenda i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; display: inline-block; }
.tooltip { position: fixed; z-index: 200; pointer-events: none; background: var(--text); color: #fff; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-2); max-width: 260px; }
/* Analisis Papan Pemuka */
.statistik-jalur { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 28px; margin: 0 24px; padding: 14px 0 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 14px; }
.statistik-jalur:empty { display: none; }
.statistik-jalur .stat { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
.statistik-jalur .stat[data-tip] { cursor: help; }
.statistik-jalur .num { font-size: 16px; }
.elips { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.seg-penuh { display: flex; width: 100%; }
.seg-penuh button { flex: 1 1 0; padding: 7px 8px; white-space: nowrap; }
.bil-tab { display: inline-block; min-width: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(22,33,58,.08); font-size: 12px; margin-left: 2px; }
.lagi-pautan { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-top: 8px; }
.carta-svg .garis-median { stroke: var(--text-3); stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-dasharray: 5 4; }
.carta-svg .label-sukuan { fill: var(--text-3); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.carta-svg .label-paksi { fill: var(--text-2); font-size: 12px; }
.carta-svg .titik { cursor: pointer; transition: r .15s; }
.carta-svg .titik:hover { r: 8; fill-opacity: 1; }
.an-utama { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.an-utama .num { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: var(--text); }
.bar-tindan { display: flex; height: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; background: #EEF1F6; gap: 2px; }
.bar-tindan > i { display: block; height: 100%; }
.an-legenda { list-style: none; margin: 14px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.an-legenda li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 14px; }
.an-legenda li i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; flex: none; }
.an-legenda li .kecil { min-width: 36px; text-align: right; }
.an-bar-kepala { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px 12px; }
.an-label { flex: 1 1 180px; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.an-bar .muted { font-size: 12px; }
.an-bar-kepala .num { white-space: nowrap; }
.jadual.padat td { padding: 10px 12px; }
.jadual.padat th { padding: 8px 12px; }
.skrol-x { overflow-x: auto; }
.bar-mendatar { height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #EEF1F6; overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
.bar-mendatar > i { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); }
.bar-mendatar .penanda { position: absolute; top: -3px; bottom: -3px; width: 2px; background: var(--text); border-radius: 1px; }
.bertindan { display: flex; height: 12px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; gap: 2px; background: transparent; }
.bertindan > i { display: block; height: 100%; }

/* ---------- Menu ⋯ ---------- */
.menu-titik { position: relative; display: inline-block; }
.menu-titik .senarai-menu { position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 4px); background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-3);
  padding: 6px; min-width: 200px; z-index: 60; display: none; text-align: left; }
.menu-titik.buka .senarai-menu { display: block; }
.senarai-menu button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
  font: inherit; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; }
.senarai-menu button:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
.senarai-menu button[disabled] { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }

/* ---------- Modal, laci, toast ---------- */
.latar { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(22,33,58,.42); z-index: 100; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; }
.modal { background: #fff; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-3); width: 100%; max-width: 560px; max-height: calc(100vh - 32px);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
.modal.lebar { max-width: 860px; } .modal.a4 { max-width: 880px; }
.modal-kepala { padding: 20px 24px 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.modal-badan { padding: 16px 24px 24px; overflow-y: auto; }
.modal-kaki { padding: 16px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.laci-latar { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(22,33,58,.32); z-index: 90; }
.laci { position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: min(520px, 100%); background: #fff; z-index: 95; box-shadow: var(--shadow-3);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; animation: masukKanan .2s ease; border-radius: 20px 0 0 20px; }
@keyframes masukKanan { from { transform: translateX(40px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
.laci-kepala { padding: 22px 24px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.laci-badan { padding: 20px 24px; overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; background: var(--bg); }
.laci-kaki { padding: 14px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.laci-kaki .btn { flex: 1; }
#toast-container { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; z-index: 300; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; pointer-events: none; max-width: calc(100vw - 48px); }
.toast { pointer-events: auto; width: 360px; max-width: 100%; background: #fff; border: 0; border-left: 4px solid var(--primary);
  border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-3); padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; font-size: 14px;
  transition: all .3s ease; transform: translateY(12px); opacity: 0; white-space: pre-line; }
.toast.papar { transform: none; opacity: 1; }
.toast.success { border-left-color: var(--success); } .toast.success .ms { color: var(--success); }
.toast.error { border-left-color: var(--danger); } .toast.error .ms { color: var(--danger); }
.toast.warning { border-left-color: var(--warning); } .toast.warning .ms { color: var(--warning); }
.muat-global { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: var(--bg); z-index: 500; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; color: var(--text-2); }
.pusing { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 3px solid var(--primary-light); border-top-color: var(--primary); border-radius: 50%; animation: pusing .8s linear infinite; }
.pusing.kecil { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-width: 2px; }
@keyframes pusing { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.rangka { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ECEFF5 25%, #F6F8FB 50%, #ECEFF5 75%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: kilau 1.2s infinite; border-radius: 14px; }
@keyframes kilau { to { background-position: -200% 0; } }

/* ---------- Kemajuan & stepper ---------- */
.kemajuan { height: 10px; background: #EEF1F6; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; }
.kemajuan > i { display: block; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #2CB1A1); border-radius: 9999px; transition: width .4s ease; }
.stepper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 24px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; }
.stepper .langkah { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--text-3); font-weight: 500; }
.stepper .langkah .no { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: #EBEFF6; color: var(--text-3); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
.stepper .langkah.aktif { color: var(--primary); } .stepper .langkah.aktif .no { background: var(--primary); color: #fff; }
.stepper .langkah.siap { color: var(--success); } .stepper .langkah.siap .no { background: var(--success); color: #fff; }
.stepper .garis { flex: 1; min-width: 24px; height: 2px; background: #EBEFF6; }
.stepper .garis.siap { background: var(--success); }
.zon-lepas { display: block; width: 100%; border: 2px dashed var(--border-input); border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 44px 20px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; background: var(--surface-2); transition: all .15s; }
.zon-lepas:hover, .zon-lepas.atas { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--teal-bg); }
.zon-lepas .ms { font-size: 44px; color: var(--accent); display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
.zon-lepas h3, .zon-lepas p { display: block; }
.zon-lepas .btn { display: inline-flex; }
.zon-lepas .btn .ms { font-size: 17px; display: inline-block; margin: 0; }

/* ---------- Jawatankuasa (kad) ---------- */
.kad-jk { display: flex; flex-direction: column; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s; }
.kad-jk:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-2); }
.kad-jk .jalur { height: 6px; border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; }
.kad-jk .isi { padding: 18px 20px 20px; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.kad-jk .nama { font-weight: 600; line-height: 21px; }
.kad-jk .meta { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-2); }
.kad-jk .status { margin-top: auto; font-size: 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.jalur.UTAMA { background: var(--ungu); } .jalur.SOKONGAN { background: var(--biru); } .jalur.SAMPINGAN { background: #B8C2D3; }

/* ---------- Senarai jawatankuasa (satu baris + kembang ahli) ---------- */
.kepala-kumpulan { padding: 16px 20px 8px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
.baris-jk { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px 12px 14px; border-top: 1px solid #F0F3F8; cursor: pointer; }
.kad > .baris-jk:first-child { border-top: 0; border-radius: var(--r-card) var(--r-card) 0 0; }
.baris-jk:hover { background: #FAFBFE; }
.baris-jk.buka { background: var(--surface-2); }
.baris-jk.tak-aktif .nama { color: var(--text-3); }
.baris-jk .kembang { color: var(--text-3); }
.baris-jk .nama { font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; }
.baris-jk .meta { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-2); }
.titik-tahap { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
.titik-tahap.UTAMA { background: var(--ungu); } .titik-tahap.SOKONGAN { background: var(--biru); } .titik-tahap.SAMPINGAN { background: #B8C2D3; }
.isi-jk { padding: 4px 20px 16px 62px; background: var(--surface-2); }
.senarai-ahli { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(150px, max-content) 1fr; gap: 6px 20px; font-size: 14px; }
.senarai-ahli .jawatan { color: var(--text-2); }
/* Tajuk unit (rumah sukan, kelab, badan beruniform) */
.senarai-ahli .tajuk-unit { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--border); font-weight: 600; color: var(--ungu); font-size: 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.senarai-ahli .tajuk-unit:first-child { margin-top: 0; padding-top: 0; border-top: 0; }
#kadPosisi .tajuk-unit { padding: 14px 24px 6px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ungu); font-size: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--ungu-bg); border-top: 1px solid #E6DEFF; }
.senarai-ahli mark { background: var(--kuning-bg); color: inherit; padding: 0 2px; border-radius: 4px; }
@media (max-width: 767px) { .isi-jk { padding: 4px 16px 14px 40px; } .senarai-ahli { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0 0; } .senarai-ahli .nama-ahli { margin-bottom: 8px; } }

/* ---------- Agihan (2 panel: posisi + pemilih dalam laci) ---------- */
.agihan { display: block; }
.item-posisi { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; grid-template-areas: "nama skor btn" "slot slot slot"; gap: 8px 12px; align-items: center; padding: 14px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #F0F3F8; }
.item-posisi > .posisi-nama { grid-area: nama; min-width: 0; } .item-posisi > .slot { grid-area: slot; } .item-posisi > .kanan { grid-area: skor; } .item-posisi > .btn-ikon { grid-area: btn; }
.item-posisi > .butir { grid-column: 1 / -1; height: 34px; font-size: 13px; }
.item-posisi.kosong-wajib { background: #FFF8F8; }
.item-posisi.sasaran { background: var(--teal-bg); box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.item-posisi .slot { border: 1.5px dashed var(--border-input); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  cursor: pointer; background: #fff; min-width: 0; }
.item-posisi .slot:hover { border-color: var(--accent); background: #FBFEFD; }
.item-posisi .slot.diisi { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--border); }
.item-posisi .slot .nm { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.kad-guru { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px; background: #fff; }
.kad-guru + .kad-guru { margin-top: 10px; }
.kad-guru.terbaik { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--teal-bg); }
.kad-guru .banding { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; margin: 10px 0; }
.bar-simpan { position: fixed; left: calc(var(--sidebar-w) + 24px); right: 24px; bottom: 20px; background: var(--text); color: #fff; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-3);
  padding: 12px 16px 12px 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; z-index: 35; }
.bar-simpan .kecil { color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); }
.bar-simpan .btn { border-color: transparent; }
.bar-simpan .btn:not(.utama) { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); color: #fff; }
.bar-simpan .btn.utama { background: #fff; color: var(--text); box-shadow: none; }
body.sidebar-kecil .bar-simpan { left: 100px; }
.titik { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FBBF24; flex-shrink: 0; }
.amaran-sebaris { margin: 6px 24px 12px; }

/* ---------- Surat A4 ---------- */
.a4 .kertas { background: #fff; width: 100%; max-width: 794px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 48px 56px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; color: #111; }
.a4 .kertas table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 10px 0; font-size: 12px; }
.a4 .kertas table th, .a4 .kertas table td { border: 1px solid #94A3B8; padding: 5px 8px; text-align: left; }
.a4 .kertas table th { background: #E8EEF5; }
.a4 .latar-surat { background: #E6EAF1; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; }
.kepala-surat { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid #111; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.kepala-surat img { width: 72px; height: 72px; object-fit: contain; }

/* ---------- Tugas Saya ---------- */
.gauge-bungkus { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
.gauge-nilai { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; margin-top: 4px; letter-spacing: -.02em; }

/* ---------- Tetapan ---------- */
.nav-tetapan { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 8px; }
.nav-tetapan a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text-2); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; }
.nav-tetapan a:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); }
.nav-tetapan a.aktif { background: var(--biru-bg); color: var(--biru); }
.nav-tetapan .pemisah { height: 1px; background: var(--border); margin: 8px 4px; }

/* ---------- Mudah alih ---------- */
.menu-mudah { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 1279px) {
  body:not(.sidebar-besar) .sidebar { width: 76px; }
  body:not(.sidebar-besar) .sidebar .jenama { justify-content: center; padding: 18px 0; }
  body:not(.sidebar-besar) .sidebar .jenama .teks, body:not(.sidebar-besar) .nav li a span.label, body:not(.sidebar-besar) .sidebar .kaki .versi { display: none; }
  body:not(.sidebar-besar) .sidebar .kaki { justify-content: center; }
  body:not(.sidebar-besar) .kolum-utama { margin-left: 76px; }
  body:not(.sidebar-besar) .nav li a { justify-content: center; padding: 11px 0; }
  body:not(.sidebar-besar) .bar-simpan { left: 100px; }

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (typeof google === 'undefined' || !google.script) {
      reject(new Error('google.script.run tidak tersedia.'));
      return;
    }
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        if (!res) { reject(new Error('Tiada respons daripada pelayan.')); return; }
        if (res.success) { resolve(res); return; }
        const e = new Error(res.message || 'Ralat tidak diketahui.');
        e.code = res.code;
        e.data = res.data;
        reject(e);

      .withFailureHandler(err => reject(new Error(err && err.message ? err.message : String(err))))
      .exec(fn, [payload || {}]);

// Data sampai selepas pengguna bertukar halaman: elemen halaman lama sudah tiada. Bukan ralat sebenar.
function paparanLama_(e) {

function nombor(n, dp) {

function satu(n) { return n === null || n === undefined || n === '' ? '-' : Number(n).toFixed(1); }

const BULAN = ['Januari', 'Februari', 'Mac', 'April', 'Mei', 'Jun', 'Julai', 'Ogos', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Disember'];

function tarikhPanjang(iso) {

function hariIniISO() {

function peta(arr, k) { const m = {}; (arr || []).forEach(x => { m[x[k]] = x; }); return m; }
function namaBidang(id) { const b = (S.rujukan.bidang || []).find(x => x.id_bidang === id); return b ? b.nama : (id || '-'); }

function cipTag(tagStr) {

function cipStatus(s) {
  const k = { AKTIF: 'hijau', CUTI: 'ambar', BERTUKAR_KELUAR: 'kelabu' }[s] || 'kelabu';

function paginasi(jumlah, muka, saiz, onKlik) {
  const bil = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(jumlah / saiz));
  const id = 'pg' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
  setTimeout(() => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);

    el.addEventListener('click', ev => {
      const b = ev.target.closest('button[data-m]');

/** Muat turun surat PDF melalui pelayan (fail tidak perlu dikongsi di Drive). */
function muatTurunSurat(idSurat, btn) {
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; }
  api('muatTurunSurat', { id_surat: idSurat }).then(res => {
    const bin = atob(res.data.base64);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: 'application/pdf' }));
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = res.data.nama;
    a.target = '_self';
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    try { a.click(); } catch (e) { window.open(url, '_blank'); }
    a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60000);
  }).catch(ralat).finally(() => { if (btn) btn.disabled = false; });
}

function bacaFail(file, sebagai) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = () => resolve(r.result);
    r.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Gagal membaca fail.'));
    if (sebagai === 'dataurl') r.readAsDataURL(file); else r.readAsText(file);
  });
}

function showToast(message, type, duration) {
  type = type || 'info';

  const t = document.createElement('div');
  t.className = 'toast ' + type;
  const ik = { success: 'check_circle', error: 'error', warning: 'warning', info: 'info' }[type] || 'info';
  t.innerHTML = ikon(ik) + '<div class="flex-1">' + esc(message) + '</div>';
  c.appendChild(t);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => t.classList.add('papar'));
  setTimeout(() => { t.classList.remove('papar'); setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 300); }, duration || 3500);
}

function bukaModal(o) {
  const latar = document.createElement('div');
  latar.className = 'latar';
  latar.innerHTML = '<div class="modal ' + (o.saiz || '') + '" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"' + (o.id ? ' id="' + o.id + '"' : '') + '>' +
    '<div class="modal-kepala"><h2>' + esc(o.tajuk) + '</h2><button class="btn-ikon" data-tutup aria-label="Tutup">' + ikon('close') + '</button></div>' +
    '<div class="modal-badan">' + (o.badan || '') + '</div>' +
    (o.kaki !== undefined ? '<div class="modal-kaki">' + o.kaki + '</div>' : '') + '</div>';
  document.getElementById('akarModal').appendChild(latar);
  const tutup = () => { latar.remove(); if (o.onTutup) o.onTutup(); };
  latar.addEventListener('click', ev => {
    if (ev.target === latar && !o.lekat) tutup();
    if (ev.target.closest('[data-tutup]')) tutup();
  });
  const onKey = ev => { if (ev.key === 'Escape' && document.body.contains(latar)) { tutup(); document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); } };
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  const m = latar.querySelector('.modal');
  m.tutup = tutup;
  const f = m.querySelector('input:not([type=hidden]), select, textarea');
  if (f && !o.tanpaFokus) setTimeout(() => f.focus(), 50);
  if (o.onBuka) o.onBuka(m);
  return m;
}

function sahkan(tajuk, mesej, labelYa, bahaya) {

(function pasangTooltip() {
  let tip = null;
  document.addEventListener('mouseover', ev => {
    const el = ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('[data-tip]');
    if (!el) return;
    if (!tip) { tip = document.createElement('div'); tip.className = 'tooltip'; document.body.appendChild(tip); }
    tip.innerHTML = esc(el.getAttribute('data-tip')).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
    tip.style.display = 'block';
  });
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', ev => {
    if (!tip || tip.style.display !== 'block') return;
    const w = tip.offsetWidth, h = tip.offsetHeight;
    let x = ev.clientX + 14, y = ev.clientY + 14;
    if (x + w > window.innerWidth - 8) x = ev.clientX - w - 14;
    if (y + h > window.innerHeight - 8) y = ev.clientY - h - 14;
    tip.style.left = x + 'px';
    tip.style.top = y + 'px';
  });
  document.addEventListener('mouseout', ev => {
    const el = ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('[data-tip]');
    if (el && tip && !(ev.relatedTarget && el.contains(ev.relatedTarget))) tip.style.display = 'none';
  });
})();

/**
 * Alamat halaman (hash). Web app Apps Script berjalan dalam iframe sandbox, jadi guna
 * google.script.history / google.script.url; history pelayar biasa hanya untuk ujian tempatan.
 */
function adaSejarahGAS() { return typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.history && google.script.url; }
function tetapHash(id) {
  try {
    if (adaSejarahGAS()) google.script.history.replace(null, null, id);
    else if (location.hash !== '#' + id) history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + id);
  } catch (e) { /* abaikan: navigasi tetap berfungsi tanpa hash */ }
}
function bacaHashAwal(cb) {
  try {
    if (adaSejarahGAS()) { google.script.url.getLocation(loc => cb(String(loc.hash || ''))); return; }
  } catch (e) { /* guna lalai */ }
  cb(location.hash.replace('#', ''));
}

function pergi(id, param, paksa) {
  if (LALUAN_LAMA[id]) { param = Object.assign({}, LALUAN_LAMA[id][1], param || {}); id = LALUAN_LAMA[id][0]; }
  const h = halamanDibenar().find(x => x.id === id && !x.pemisah) || halamanDibenar().find(x => x.id === halamanLalai());
  if (!paksa && S.halaman && S.halaman !== h.id && !sahkanTinggalAgihan()) {
    tetapHash(S.halaman);
    return;
  }
  if (S.halaman !== h.id) hentiPollJob();
  S.halaman = h.id;
  S.param = param || {};
  $$('[data-hal]').forEach(a => a.classList.toggle('aktif', a.dataset.hal === (h.induk || h.id)));
  tetapHash(h.id);
  tutupLaci();
  document.getElementById('akarModal').innerHTML = '';
  const bar = $('#barSimpan');
  if (bar) bar.remove();
  $('#kandungan').innerHTML = '';
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  h.render();
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. CARTA (SVG tulen)
// ============================================================================
const WARNA_ZON = { kurang: '#B45309', seimbang: '#15803D', terbeban: '#B91C1C' };

function laluanBar(x, y, w, h, r) {
  if (h <= 0) return '';
  r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h);
  return 'M' + x + ',' + (y + h) + 'V' + (y + r) + 'Q' + x + ',' + y + ' ' + (x + r) + ',' + y + 'H' + (x + w - r) +
    'Q' + (x + w) + ',' + y + ' ' + (x + w) + ',' + (y + r) + 'V' + (y + h) + 'Z';
}

function langkahPaksi(maks) {
  if (maks <= 5) return 1;
  const kasar = maks / 5;
  const p = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(kasar)));
  const n = kasar / p;
  return (n <= 1 ? 1 : n <= 2 ? 2 : n <= 5 ? 5 : 10) * p;
}

function cartaHistogram(nilai, tetapan) {
  const rendah = Number(tetapan.AMBANG_RENDAH), tinggi = Number(tetapan.AMBANG_TINGGI);
  if (!nilai.length) return kosong('bar_chart', 'Tiada data indeks', 'Tambah guru, masa mengajar dan lantikan untuk melihat taburan.');
  // Lebar bin ikut julat: 0.1 bagi julat biasa, lebih lebar jika indeks atau ambang tinggi
  const maksData = Math.max.apply(null, nilai);
  const julatAtas = Math.max(2.0, Math.min(Math.max(maksData, tinggi + 0.3), 10));
  const lb = julatAtas <= 3 ? 0.1 : julatAtas <= 6 ? 0.25 : 0.5;
  const mn = Math.min(0.4, Math.floor(Math.min.apply(null, nilai) / lb) * lb);
  const mx = Math.ceil(julatAtas / lb) * lb;
  const bil = Math.round((mx - mn) / lb);
  const bin = new Array(bil).fill(0);
  nilai.forEach(v => {
    let i = Math.floor((Math.min(v, mx - 0.0001) - mn) / lb + 1e-9);
    bin[Math.max(0, Math.min(bil - 1, i))]++;
  });
  const W = 640, H = 260, pl = 36, pr = 12, pt = 28, pb = 30;
  const lw = (W - pl - pr) / bil;
  const ymax = Math.max(1, Math.max.apply(null, bin));
  const lk = langkahPaksi(ymax);
  const yTop = Math.ceil(ymax / lk) * lk;
  const sy = v => pt + (H - pt - pb) * (1 - v / yTop);
  const sx = v => pl + (v - mn) / lb * lw;
  let s = '<svg class="carta-svg" viewBox="0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H + '" role="img" aria-label="Histogram taburan Indeks Beban">';
  for (let v = 0; v <= yTop; v += lk) {
    s += '<line class="grid-line" x1="' + pl + '" x2="' + (W - pr) + '" y1="' + sy(v) + '" y2="' + sy(v) + '"/>';
    s += '<text x="' + (pl - 6) + '" y="' + (sy(v) + 4) + '" text-anchor="end">' + v + '</text>';
  }
  bin.forEach((n, i) => {
    const a = mn + i * lb, b = a + lb, tengah = (a + b) / 2;
    const z = tengah > tinggi ? 'terbeban' : tengah < rendah ? 'kurang' : 'seimbang';
    const x = pl + i * lw + 1, w = lw - 2;
    const tip = a.toFixed(2) + ' - ' + b.toFixed(2) + (i === bil - 1 && maksData >= mx ? '+' : '') + ': ' + n + ' guru (' + labelZon(z) + ')';
    s += '<rect x="' + (pl + i * lw) + '" y="' + pt + '" width="' + lw + '" height="' + (H - pt - pb) + '" fill="transparent" data-tip="' + esc(tip) + '"/>';
    if (n > 0) s += '<path class="bar" d="' + laluanBar(x, sy(n), w, sy(0) - sy(n), 3) + '" fill="' + WARNA_ZON[z] + '" data-tip="' + esc(tip) + '"/>';
  });
  s += '<line class="paksi" x1="' + pl + '" x2="' + (W - pr) + '" y1="' + sy(0) + '" y2="' + sy(0) + '"/>';
  for (let i = 0; i <= bil; i += (bil > 20 ? 2 : 1)) {
    const v = mn + i * lb;
    s += '<text x="' + sx(v) + '" y="' + (H - pb + 16) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + (lb < 0.25 ? v.toFixed(1) : String(Math.round(v * 100) / 100)) + '</text>';
  }
  // Label ambang: Rendah ke kiri garis, Tinggi ke kanan garis supaya tidak bertindih
  [[rendah, 'Rendah ' + rendah, WARNA_ZON.kurang, 'end'], [tinggi, 'Tinggi ' + tinggi, WARNA_ZON.terbeban, 'start']].forEach(a => {
    if (a[0] < mn || a[0] > mx) return;
    const x = sx(a[0]);
    let anc = a[3];
    if (anc === 'end' && x - pl < 70) anc = 'start';
    if (anc === 'start' && W - pr - x < 70) anc = 'end';
    s += '<line x1="' + x + '" x2="' + x + '" y1="' + (pt - 6) + '" y2="' + sy(0) + '" stroke="' + a[2] + '" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>';
    s += '<text x="' + (x + (anc === 'end' ? -5 : 5)) + '" y="' + (pt - 10) + '" text-anchor="' + anc + '" style="fill:' + a[2] + ';font-weight:600">' + esc(a[1]) + '</text>';
  });
  s += '</svg>';
  return s;
}

/** Serakan masa mengajar (paksi X, masa) lawan skor tugas (paksi Y), dengan garis median dan label sukuan. */
function cartaSerakan(guru, rujukan, t) {
  const titik = guru.filter(g => g.indeks !== null);
  if (!titik.length) return kosong('scatter_plot', 'Tiada data', 'Isi masa mengajar dan lantikan untuk melihat carta ini.');
  const X = g => keMasa(g.M), Y = g => Number(g.T) || 0;
  const medX = keMasa(rujukan.M || 0), medY = Number(rujukan.T) || 0;
  const W = 900, H = 320, pl = 44, pr = 16, pt = 16, pb = 40;
  const mxX = Math.max(medX * 1.6, ...titik.map(X), 1), mxY = Math.max(medY * 2, ...titik.map(Y), 1);
  const lkX = langkahPaksi(mxX), lkY = langkahPaksi(mxY);
  const topX = Math.ceil(mxX / lkX) * lkX, topY = Math.ceil(mxY / lkY) * lkY;
  const sx = v => pl + (W - pl - pr) * v / topX, sy = v => pt + (H - pt - pb) * (1 - v / topY);
  let s = '<svg class="carta-svg" viewBox="0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H + '" role="img" aria-label="Carta serakan masa mengajar lawan skor tugas">';
  for (let v = 0; v <= topY + 1e-9; v += lkY) s += '<line class="grid-line" x1="' + pl + '" x2="' + (W - pr) + '" y1="' + sy(v) + '" y2="' + sy(v) + '"/><text x="' + (pl - 6) + '" y="' + (sy(v) + 4) + '" text-anchor="end">' + Math.round(v * 10) / 10 + '</text>';
  for (let v = 0; v <= topX + 1e-9; v += lkX) s += '<text x="' + sx(v) + '" y="' + (H - pb + 16) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + Math.round(v * 10) / 10 + '</text>';
  s += '<text x="' + ((pl + W - pr) / 2) + '" y="' + (H - 4) + '" text-anchor="middle" class="label-paksi">Masa mengajar seminggu</text>';
  s += '<text x="12" y="' + ((pt + H - pb) / 2) + '" text-anchor="middle" class="label-paksi" transform="rotate(-90 12 ' + ((pt + H - pb) / 2) + ')">Skor tugas JK</text>';
  // Garis median & label sukuan
  s += '<line x1="' + sx(medX) + '" x2="' + sx(medX) + '" y1="' + pt + '" y2="' + sy(0) + '" class="garis-median"/>';
  s += '<line x1="' + pl + '" x2="' + (W - pr) + '" y1="' + sy(medY) + '" y2="' + sy(medY) + '" class="garis-median"/>';
  [[pl + 8, pt + 14, 'start', 'Tugas berat, kelas ringan'], [W - pr - 8, pt + 14, 'end', 'Berat kedua-duanya'],
   [pl + 8, sy(0) - 8, 'start', 'Boleh diberi tugas'], [W - pr - 8, sy(0) - 8, 'end', 'Kelas berat, tugas ringan']]
    .forEach(q => { s += '<text x="' + q[0] + '" y="' + q[1] + '" text-anchor="' + q[2] + '" class="label-sukuan">' + q[3] + '</text>'; });
  titik.forEach(g => {
    const z = zon(g.indeks, t);
    s += '<circle cx="' + sx(X(g)) + '" cy="' + sy(Y(g)) + '" r="6" fill="' + (WARNA_ZON[z] || '#8592A8') + '" fill-opacity=".75" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.5" class="titik" data-guru="' + esc(g.id_guru) + '"' +
      ' data-tip="' + esc(g.nama + ': ' + teksMasa(g.M) + ' masa, ' + satu(g.T) + ' mata, indeks ' + dua(g.indeks)) + '"/>';
  });
  return s + '</svg>';
}

/** Bar mendatar nilai berbanding median (penanda hitam = median). */
function barBanding(label, nilai, median, unit, warna) {
  const skala = Math.max(nilai, median * 2, 1);
  const dp = x => unit === 'mata' || Math.abs(x % 1) > 0.001 ? 1 : 0;
  return '<div><div class="baris antara kecil"><span>' + esc(label) + '</span><span class="num"><b>' + esc(nombor(nilai, dp(nilai))) + ' ' + esc(unit) + '</b> <span class="muted">/ median ' + esc(nombor(median, dp(median))) + '</span></span></div>' +
    '<div class="bar-mendatar mt-8"><i style="width:' + Math.min(100, nilai / skala * 100) + '%;background:' + (warna || 'var(--primary)') + '"></i>' +
    '<span class="penanda" style="left:' + (median / skala * 100) + '%" data-tip="Median sekolah: ' + esc(nombor(median, 1)) + '"></span></div></div>';
}

function gaugeIndeks(indeks, tetapan) {
  const maks = 2, R = 80, cx = 100, cy = 100;
  const sudut = v => Math.PI * (1 - Math.min(maks, Math.max(0, v)) / maks);
  const titik = v => [cx + R * Math.cos(sudut(v)), cy - R * Math.sin(sudut(v))];
  const arka = (a, b, warna) => {
    const p1 = titik(a), p2 = titik(b);
    return '<path d="M' + p1[0] + ',' + p1[1] + ' A' + R + ',' + R + ' 0 0 1 ' + p2[0] + ',' + p2[1] + '" stroke="' + warna + '" stroke-width="16" fill="none"/>';
  };
  const rendah = Number(tetapan.AMBANG_RENDAH), tinggi = Number(tetapan.AMBANG_TINGGI);
  let s = '<svg viewBox="0 0 200 118" style="width:100%;max-width:280px" role="img" aria-label="Tolok Indeks Beban">';
  s += arka(0, rendah, '#FDE68A') + arka(rendah, tinggi, '#BBF7D0') + arka(tinggi, maks, '#FECACA');
  if (indeks !== null && indeks !== undefined) {
    const p = titik(indeks);
    s += '<line x1="' + cx + '" y1="' + cy + '" x2="' + p[0] + '" y2="' + p[1] + '" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>';
    s += '<circle cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" r="6" fill="#0F172A"/>';
  }
  s += '<text x="20" y="116" font-size="9" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">0</text><text x="180" y="116" font-size="9" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">2.0+</text></svg>';
  return s;
}

function muatPapan() {
  api('getDashboard', { tahun: S.tahun, tapis: {} }).then(res => {
    if (S.halaman !== 'papan') return;
    const d = res.data, t = d.tetapan, k = d.kpi;
    $('#teksKira').textContent = 'Tahun ' + d.tahun + ' · median beban ' + dua(k.medianIndeks) + ' · dikira ' + tarikhMasa(d.tarikh_kira);
    $('#kpiRow').innerHTML = [
      { warna: 'biru', ikon: 'groups', label: 'Guru aktif', nilai: nombor(k.guruAktif), nota: 'Purata ' + satu(k.purataLantikan) + ' jawatan seorang', go: adalahAdmin() ? 'guru' : '' },
      { warna: 'ungu', ikon: 'assignment_ind', label: 'Lantikan', nilai: nombor(k.jumlahLantikan), nota: 'Tahun ' + d.tahun, go: 'jk' },
      { warna: 'jambu', ikon: 'local_fire_department', label: 'Guru terbeban', nilai: nombor(k.w01), nota: k.w02 + ' guru kurang beban', go: adalahAdmin() ? 'guru' : '', zon: 'TERBEBAN' },
      { warna: 'kuning', ikon: 'person_search', label: 'JK perlu diisi', nilai: nombor(k.w07), nota: 'Ada jawatan belum diisi', go: 'jk' }
    ].map(kadKpi).join('');
    $$('#kpiRow [data-go]').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('click', () =>
      pergi(el.dataset.go, el.dataset.zon ? { zon: el.dataset.zon } : (el.dataset.go === 'jk' && k.w07 ? { tapisW07: true } : {}))));
    $('#subTaburan').textContent = 'Seimbang antara ' + t.AMBANG_RENDAH + ' dan ' + t.AMBANG_TINGGI + ' (1.00 = median sekolah)';
    $('#histogramBeban').innerHTML = cartaHistogram(d.histogram, t);

    // Perlu perhatian: paling terbeban, paling kurang beban, JK wajib kosong
    const berindeks = d.jadual.filter(r => r.indeks !== null && r.status === 'AKTIF');
    const semuaAtas = berindeks.filter(r => r.amaran.indexOf('W01') !== -1);
    const semuaBawah = berindeks.filter(r => r.amaran.indexOf('W02') !== -1).reverse();
    const atas = semuaAtas.slice(0, 5), bawah = semuaBawah.slice(0, 5);
    const jk = (k.jkPerluDiisi || []).slice(0, 5);
    const barisGuru = r => '<li data-guru="' + esc(r.id_guru) + '"><div class="avatar kecil">' + esc(inisial(r.nama)) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="flex-1"><div class="nama">' + esc(r.nama) + '</div><div class="sangat-kecil muted">' + r.bil + ' jawatan · ' + teksMasa(r.M) + ' masa</div></div>' +
      pillIndeks(r.indeks, t, true) + '</li>';
    const lebih = (n, papar, pautan) => n > papar ? '<a href="#' + pautan + '" class="kecil lagi-pautan">+ ' + (n - papar) + ' lagi ' + ikon('arrow_forward', 'sm') + '</a>' : '';
    const panel = {
      atas: atas.length ? '<ul class="senarai-ringkas">' + atas.map(barisGuru).join('') + '</ul>' + lebih(semuaAtas.length, atas.length, 'guru') : '',
      bawah: bawah.length ? '<ul class="senarai-ringkas">' + bawah.map(barisGuru).join('') + '</ul>' + lebih(semuaBawah.length, bawah.length, 'guru') : '',
      jk: ''
    };
    if (jk.length) panel.jk = '<ul class="senarai-ringkas">' +
      jk.map(j => '<li data-jk="' + esc(j.id_jk) + '"><div class="flex-1"><div class="nama">' + esc(j.nama) + '</div><div class="sangat-kecil muted">' +
        esc(j.kosong.map(x => /kosong|ahli/.test(x) ? x : x + ' kosong').join(', ')) + '</div></div>' + ikon('chevron_right', 'sm') + '</li>').join('') + '</ul>' +
      lebih(k.w07, jk.length, 'jk');
    const tab = [['atas', 'Terbeban', semuaAtas.length], ['bawah', 'Ada ruang', semuaBawah.length], ['jk', 'JK kosong', k.w07]];
    if (!tab.some(x => x[2])) {
      $('#perluPerhatian').innerHTML = kosong('celebration', 'Semua seimbang', 'Tiada guru terbeban dan semua jawatan wajib telah diisi.');
    } else {
      let aktifTab = (tab.find(x => x[0] === S.tabPerhatian && x[2]) || tab.find(x => x[2]))[0];
      const lukisTab = () => {
        $('#perluPerhatian').innerHTML = '<div class="seg seg-penuh mb-8">' + tab.map(x => '<button data-tabp="' + x[0] + '" class="' + (x[0] === aktifTab ? 'aktif' : '') + '">' +
          esc(x[1]) + ' <span class="bil-tab">' + x[2] + '</span></button>').join('') + '</div>' +
          (panel[aktifTab] || '<p class="kecil muted" style="padding:16px 0">Tiada.</p>');
        $$('#perluPerhatian [data-tabp]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { aktifTab = S.tabPerhatian = b.dataset.tabp; lukisTab(); });
        $$('#perluPerhatian [data-guru]').forEach(li => li.addEventListener('click', () => bukaProfilGuru(li.dataset.guru)));
        $$('#perluPerhatian [data-jk]').forEach(li => li.addEventListener('click', () => pergi('agihan', { idJk: li.dataset.jk })));
        $$('#perluPerhatian .lagi-pautan').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', ev => {
          if (aktifTab === 'jk') { ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation(); pergi('jk', { tapisW07: true }); }
          else if (aktifTab === 'atas') { ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation(); pergi('guru', { zon: 'TERBEBAN' }); }
        }));
      };
      lukisTab();
    }
    lukisAnalisis(d);
  }).catch(e => {
    ralat(e);
    const t = $('#perluPerhatian');
    if (t) t.innerHTML = kosong('error', 'Gagal memuatkan papan pemuka', e.message);
  });
}

function kadAnalisis(id, tajuk, sub) {
  return '<div class="kad"><div class="kad-kepala"><div><h3>' + esc(tajuk) + '</h3><div class="sub">' + esc(sub) + '</div></div></div>' +
    '<div class="kad-badan" id="' + id + '">' + rangka(160) + '</div></div>';
}
/** Bar bertindan + legenda dengan bilangan. bahagian: [[label, n, warna]] */
function barBertindan(bahagian, jumlah, nilaiUtama, labelUtama) {
  jumlah = jumlah || bahagian.reduce((s, b) => s + b[1], 0);
  return '<div class="an-utama"><span class="num">' + esc(nilaiUtama) + '</span><span class="kecil muted">' + esc(labelUtama) + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="bar-tindan">' + bahagian.filter(b => b[1] > 0).map(b => '<i style="width:' + (b[1] / (jumlah || 1) * 100) + '%;background:' + b[2] + '" data-tip="' + esc(b[0] + ': ' + b[1]) + '"></i>').join('') + '</div>' +
    '<ul class="an-legenda">' + bahagian.map(b => '<li><i style="background:' + b[2] + '"></i><span class="flex-1">' + esc(b[0]) + '</span><b class="num">' + b[1] + '</b>' +
      '<span class="muted num kecil">' + (jumlah ? Math.round(b[1] / jumlah * 100) : 0) + '%</span></li>').join('') + '</ul>';
}
function barisBar(label, nilai, maks, teks, warna, sub) {
  return '<div class="an-bar"><div class="an-bar-kepala kecil"><span class="an-label">' + label + (sub ? '<span class="muted">' + esc(sub) + '</span>' : '') + '</span><b class="num">' + esc(teks) + '</b></div>' +
    '<div class="bar-mendatar mt-8"><i style="width:' + (maks > 0 && nilai > 0 ? Math.max(2, nilai / maks * 100) : 0) + '%;background:' + (warna || 'var(--primary)') + '"></i></div></div>';
}
function lukisAnalisis(d) {
  const t = d.tetapan, an = d.analisis || {}, J = d.jadual || [];
  const aktif = J.filter(g => g.status === 'AKTIF');
  const set = (id, h) => { const el = $('#' + id); if (el) el.innerHTML = h; };

  // Statistik ringkas indeks
  const ind = aktif.filter(g => g.indeks !== null && !g.dikecualikan).sort((a, b) => a.indeks - b.indeks);
  if (ind.length) {
    // Jalur ringkas: label + nilai sebaris; nama guru dalam tooltip
    const st = (label, nilai, nota) => '<div class="stat"' + (nota ? ' data-tip="' + esc(nota) + '"' : '') + '><span class="muted">' + esc(label) + '</span><b class="num">' + nilai + '</b></div>';
    const median = d.kpi.medianIndeks;
    set('statIndeks', st('Median', dua(median), 'Separuh guru berada di bawah nilai ini') +
      st('Terendah', dua(ind[0].indeks), ind[0].nama) + st('Tertinggi', dua(ind[ind.length - 1].indeks), ind[ind.length - 1].nama) +
      st('Guru dikira', ind.length + (aktif.length - ind.length ? ' <span class="muted kecil">/ ' + aktif.length + '</span>' : ''), aktif.length - ind.length ? (aktif.length - ind.length) + ' guru dikecualikan atau tiada indeks' : ''));
  } else set('statIndeks', '');
  set('cartaSerakan', cartaSerakan(aktif.filter(g => !g.dikecualikan), d.rujukan, t));
  $$('#cartaSerakan [data-guru]').forEach(c => c.addEventListener('click', () => bukaProfilGuru(c.dataset.guru)));

  // 1. Status beban
  const z = { terbeban: 0, seimbang: 0, kurang: 0, kecuali: 0, tiada: 0 };
  aktif.forEach(g => {
    if (g.dikecualikan) z.kecuali++;
    else if (g.indeks === null) z.tiada++;
    else z[zon(g.indeks, t)]++;
  });
  const berindeks = z.terbeban + z.seimbang + z.kurang;
  set('anZon', barBertindan([['Seimbang', z.seimbang, WARNA_ZON.seimbang], ['Terbeban', z.terbeban, WARNA_ZON.terbeban], ['Kurang beban', z.kurang, WARNA_ZON.kurang],
    ].concat(z.kecuali ? [['Dikecualikan (pentadbir)', z.kecuali, '#8592A8']] : [], z.tiada ? [['Tiada indeks', z.tiada, '#D3DAE5']] : []),
    aktif.length, (berindeks ? Math.round(z.seimbang / berindeks * 100) : 0) + '%', 'guru dalam julat seimbang'));

  // 2. Kelengkapan JK
  const jk = an.jk || { aktif: 0, lengkap: 0, perluDiisi: 0, tanpaAhli: 0 };
  set('anJK', barBertindan([['Lengkap', jk.lengkap, 'var(--hijau)'], ['Ada jawatan kosong', jk.perluDiisi, 'var(--kuning)'], ['Belum ada ahli', jk.tanpaAhli, 'var(--danger)']],
    jk.aktif, (jk.aktif ? Math.round(jk.lengkap / jk.aktif * 100) : 0) + '%', 'jawatankuasa lengkap') +
    (jk.perluDiisi + jk.tanpaAhli ? '<a href="#jk" class="kecil mt-8" style="display:inline-flex" data-pergi-w07>Lihat JK perlu diisi ' + ikon('arrow_forward', 'sm') + '</a>' : ''));

  // 3. Surat
  const s = an.surat || { guru: 0, siap: 0, lapuk: 0, belum: 0, dihantar: 0 };
  set('anSurat', barBertindan([['Dihantar melalui emel', s.dihantar, 'var(--hijau)'], ['Siap, belum dihantar', s.siap - s.dihantar, 'var(--biru)'],
    ['Perlu dijana semula', s.lapuk, 'var(--ungu)'], ['Belum dijana', s.belum, '#D3DAE5']],
    s.guru, (s.guru ? Math.round(s.dihantar / s.guru * 100) : 0) + '%', 'surat sudah sampai kepada guru') +
    (adalahAdmin() ? '<a href="#surat" class="kecil mt-8" style="display:inline-flex">Pergi ke Surat ' + ikon('arrow_forward', 'sm') + '</a>' : ''));

  // 4. Bidang
  const bid = an.bidang || [];
  const jumSkor = bid.reduce((x, b) => x + b.skor, 0);
  const maksSkor = Math.max(0, ...bid.map(b => b.skor));
  const warnaBid = ['var(--biru)', 'var(--teal)', 'var(--jambu)', 'var(--ungu)', 'var(--kuning)'];
  set('anBidang', bid.length ? '<div class="tindan">' + bid.map((b, i) => barisBar(esc(b.nama), b.skor, maksSkor,
    satu(b.skor) + ' mata · ' + (jumSkor ? Math.round(b.skor / jumSkor * 100) : 0) + '%', warnaBid[i % warnaBid.length],
    b.jk + ' JK · ' + b.lantikan + ' lantikan · ' + b.guru + ' guru')).join('') + '</div>' : kosong('category', 'Tiada data bidang', ''));

  // 5. Bilangan jawatan seorang
  const had = Number(t.HAD_BIL_JAWATAN) || 8;
  // [label, min, maks]; bar merah jika melebihi Had Bilangan Jawatan
  const kump = [['Tiada jawatan', 0, 0], ['1 - 3 jawatan', 1, 3], ['4 - 6 jawatan', 4, 6], ['7 - 9 jawatan', 7, 9], ['10 - 12 jawatan', 10, 12], ['13 jawatan ke atas', 13, 999]];
  const bilK = kump.map(k => [k[0], aktif.filter(g => g.bil >= k[1] && g.bil <= k[2]).length, k[1]]);
  const maksK = Math.max(0, ...bilK.map(k => k[1]));
  set('anBil', '<div class="tindan">' + bilK.map((k, i) => barisBar(esc(k[0]), k[1], maksK, k[1] + ' guru',
    i === 0 ? 'var(--kuning)' : k[2] > had ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--teal)')).join('') + '</div>' +
    '<p class="kecil muted mt-16">Had semasa: ' + had + ' jawatan. Bar merah melebihi had.</p>' +
    (bilK[0][1] ? '<p class="kecil muted mt-16">' + ikon('info', 'sm') + ' ' + bilK[0][1] + ' guru aktif belum memegang sebarang jawatan.</p>' : ''));

  // 6. Gred
  const urutGred = (S.rujukan.gred || []).map(g => g.kod_gred);
  const gred = {};
  aktif.forEach(g => { const k = g.kod_gred || '-'; (gred[k] || (gred[k] = [])).push(g); });
  const kunciGred = Object.keys(gred).sort((a, b) => {
    const ia = urutGred.indexOf(a), ib = urutGred.indexOf(b);
    return (ib === -1 ? -1 : ib) - (ia === -1 ? -1 : ia) || a.localeCompare(b);
  });
  set('anGred', kunciGred.length ? '<div class="skrol-x"><table class="jadual padat"><thead><tr><th>Gred</th><th class="num">Guru</th><th class="num">Purata jawatan</th><th>Purata indeks</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
    kunciGred.map(k => {
      const L = gred[k], ind = L.filter(g => g.indeks !== null && !g.dikecualikan).map(g => g.indeks);
      const purata = ind.length ? ind.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / ind.length : null;
      return '<tr><td><span class="gred">' + esc(k) + '</span></td><td class="num">' + L.length + '</td><td class="num">' + satu(L.reduce((a, g) => a + g.bil, 0) / L.length) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (purata === null ? '<span class="muted kecil">Dikecualikan / tiada</span>' : pillIndeks(purata, t)) + '</td></tr>';
    }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>' : kosong('military_tech', 'Tiada data gred', ''));

  // 7. Paling banyak jawatan
  const ramai = aktif.filter(g => g.bil > 0 && !g.dikecualikan).sort((a, b) => b.bil - a.bil || (b.T - a.T)).slice(0, 7);
  const maksBil = ramai.length ? ramai[0].bil : 0;
  set('anRamai', ramai.length ? '<ul class="senarai-ringkas">' + ramai.map(g => '<li data-guru="' + esc(g.id_guru) + '"><div class="avatar kecil">' + esc(inisial(g.nama)) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="flex-1" style="min-width:0"><div class="nama">' + esc(g.nama) + '</div><div class="bar-mendatar mt-8" style="height:6px"><i style="width:' + (g.bil / maksBil * 100) + '%;background:' +

function modalTukarLantikan(guruAsal, l) {
  if (!l) return;

  const m = bukaModal({
    tajuk: 'Tukar guru untuk tugas ini', saiz: 'lebar',

  });
  const indeksJika = (g, T) => {
    if (g.dikecualikan || g.status !== 'AKTIF' || !(Number(g.faktor) > 0)) return null;
    const t = TL.data.tetapan, rj = TL.data.rujukan;
    const nm = rj.M > 0 ? g.M / rj.M : 0, nt = rj.T > 0 ? T / rj.T : 0;

      (!q || g.nama.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 || String(g.kod_gred || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1))
      .map(g => ({ g, kini: g.indeks, selepas: indeksJika(g, Number(g.T) + Number(l.skor)) }))
      .sort((a, b) => (a.kini === null ? 99 : a.kini) - (b.kini === null ? 99 : b.kini) || a.g.nama.localeCompare(b.g.nama));

        '<td class="kanan">' + (TL.pilih === c.g.id_guru ? '<span class="cip hijau">' + ikon('check', 'sm') + 'Dipilih</span>' :
          '<button class="btn sm" data-pilih="' + esc(c.g.id_guru) + '">Pilih</button>') + '</td></tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table>'
      : kosong('person_search', 'Tiada guru sepadan', 'Ubah carian.');
    el.querySelectorAll('[data-pilih]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
      TL.pilih = b.dataset.pilih;
      const g = TL.data.guru.find(x => x.id_guru === TL.pilih);
      m.querySelector('#notaTukar').innerHTML = esc(guruAsal.nama) + ' → <b>' + esc(g.nama) + '</b>';
      m.querySelector('#btnTukarSimpan').disabled = false;
      lukis();
    });
  };
  const simpan = simpanJuga => {
    const btn = m.querySelector('#btnTukarSimpan');
    btn.disabled = true;
    // Hantar semua lantikan JK itu, dengan satu lantikan ditukar kepada guru baharu
    const senarai = TL.data.lantikan.filter(x => x.id_jk === l.id_jk).map(x => ({
      id_lantikan: x.id_lantikan, id_guru: x.id_lantikan === l.id_lantikan ? TL.pilih : x.id_guru, id_jawatan: x.id_jawatan,
      tarikh_kuat_kuasa: x.tarikh_kuat_kuasa, tarikh_tamat: x.tarikh_tamat, butiran: x.butiran
    }));
    api('simpanLantikanPukal', { tahun: S.tahun, id_jk: l.id_jk, senaraiLantikan: senarai, simpanJuga: !!simpanJuga }).then(res => {
      m.tutup();
      showToast('Tugas diserahkan kepada ' + TL.data.guru.find(x => x.id_guru === TL.pilih).nama + '. ' + res.message, 'success', 5000);
      bukaProfilGuru(guruAsal.id_guru);
      segarHalaman();
    }).catch(e => {
      btn.disabled = false;
      if (e.code === 409 && e.data && e.data.amaran) {
        const a = bukaModal({
          tajuk: 'Semak amaran sebelum simpan',
          badan: '<p class="muted mb-16">Amaran ini bersifat nasihat. Anda boleh pilih guru lain atau teruskan.</p>' +
            e.data.amaran.map(x => '<div class="makluman ambar mb-16">' + ikon('warning') + '<div><b>' + esc(AMARAN_LABEL[x.kod] || x.kod) + '</b>: ' + esc(x.mesej) + '</div></div>').join(''),
          kaki: '<button class="btn" data-tutup>Pilih guru lain</button><button class="btn utama" id="btnTukarJuga">Simpan Juga</button>'
        });
        a.querySelector('#btnTukarJuga').onclick = () => { a.tutup(); simpan(true); };
        return;
      }
      ralat(e);
    });
  };
  m.querySelector('#btnTukarSimpan').onclick = () => simpan(false);
  m.querySelector('#cariTukar').addEventListener('input', debounce(ev => { TL.cari = ev.target.value; lukis(); }, 200));
  api('getDataAgihan', { tahun: S.tahun }).then(res => { TL.data = res.data; lukis(); })
    .catch(e => { m.tutup(); ralat(e); });

  <script>
/* Sistem Agihan Tugas Guru - JS_Modul.html
 * Skrin: Lantikan (satu JK), Jawatankuasa, Guru (termasuk masa mengajar & import CSV),
 * Surat, Tetapan (termasuk Pengguna & Log Aktiviti).
 */
'use strict';

// ============================================================================
// SUSUNAN UNIT (rumah sukan, badan beruniform, kelab & persatuan)
// ============================================================================
/**
 * JK "berunit" jika satu unit dipegang oleh lebih daripada satu jenis jawatan,
 * contohnya URANIUM: Ketua Guru Penasihat + Guru Penasihat, atau Tingkatan 2: Penyelaras + Guru Kelas.
 */
/**
 * Unit bagi butiran. Butiran tingkatan ("TINGKATAN 2", "Ting 2", "2 AL FARABI") dikumpul sebagai
 * "Tingkatan 2"; butiran lain (cth. URANIUM) ialah unit itu sendiri.
 */
function kunciUnit(butiran) {
  const b = String(butiran || '').trim();
  const m = b.match(/^(?:TINGKATAN|TING\.?|T)\s*(\d+)\b/i) || b.match(/^(\d+)\s+\S/);
  return m ? 'Tingkatan ' + Number(m[1]) : b;
}
/** Papar butiran di bawah tajuk unit hanya jika ia menambah maklumat (cth. nama kelas). */
function butiranLebih(butiran) {
  const b = String(butiran || '').trim();
  return b && b.toLowerCase() !== kunciUnit(b).toLowerCase() && !/^(?:TINGKATAN|TING\.?|T)\s*\d+$/i.test(b) ? b : '';
}
/**
 * Kedudukan butiran yang bermula dengan nama jawatan (cth. "Setiausaha PBD", "Penolong Setiausaha SPM"):
 * ikut susunan jawatan itu, padanan terpanjang menang. Butiran lain di belakang.
 */
function urutanButiran(butiran) {
  const b = String(butiran || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!b) return -1;
  let terbaik = 999, panjang = 0;
  (S.rujukan.jawatan || []).forEach((j, i) => {
    const n = String(j.nama || '').toLowerCase();
    if (n && n.length > panjang && (b === n || b.indexOf(n + ' ') === 0)) { terbaik = i; panjang = n.length; }
  });
  return terbaik;
}
/**
 * Hierarki Penolong Kanan dalam butiran (cth. Naib Pengerusi "Penolong Kanan HEM"):
 * Pentadbiran -> HEM -> Kokurikulum -> Penyelia Petang. Butiran lain di belakang.
 */
function urutanPK(butiran) {
  const b = String(butiran || '').toLowerCase();
  if (!/penolong kanan|\bpk\b|penyelia petang/.test(b)) return 99;
  if (/pentadbiran/.test(b)) return 1;
  if (/\bhem\b|hal ehwal murid/.test(b)) return 2;
  if (/kokurikulum|\bkoko\b/.test(b)) return 3;
  if (/petang/.test(b)) return 4;
  return 5;
}
/** Susun butiran dalam jawatan yang sama: ikut jawatan yang disebut, hierarki PK, kemudian abjad. */
function bandingButiran(a, b) {
  return urutanButiran(a.butiran) - urutanButiran(b.butiran) || urutanPK(a.butiran) - urutanPK(b.butiran) ||
    String(a.butiran || '').localeCompare(String(b.butiran || ''), 'ms', { numeric: true });
}
function jkBerunit(senarai) {
  const peta = {};
  (senarai || []).forEach(x => {
    const b = kunciUnit(x.butiran);
    if (!b) return;
    (peta[b] || (peta[b] = {}))[x.id_jawatan] = 1;
  });
  return Object.keys(peta).some(b => Object.keys(peta[b]).length > 1);
}
function urutanJawatan(idJaw) {
  const i = (S.rujukan.jawatan || []).findIndex(j => j.id_jawatan === idJaw);
  return i === -1 ? 999 : i;
}
/** Penyusun: tanpa unit dahulu, kemudian ikut nama unit, kemudian jawatan (Ketua -> Penolong -> Guru Penasihat). */
function bandingUnit(a, b) {
  const ua = kunciUnit(a.butiran), ub = kunciUnit(b.butiran);
  if (!ua !== !ub) return ua ? 1 : -1;
  // Dalam unit yang sama: jawatan yang meliputi seluruh unit (cth. Penyelaras 'TINGKATAN 2') dahulu, kemudian ikut kelas
  return ua.localeCompare(ub, 'ms', { numeric: true }) || (butiranLebih(a.butiran) ? 1 : 0) - (butiranLebih(b.butiran) ? 1 : 0) ||
    urutanJawatan(a.id_jawatan) - urutanJawatan(b.id_jawatan) ||
    String(a.butiran || '').localeCompare(String(b.butiran || ''), 'ms', { numeric: true });
}

const A = { data: null, idJk: null, slot: [], asal: {}, slotAktif: null, cariJK: '', bidangJK: '', cariGuru: '', susun: 'indeks',
  amaranSlot: {}, diakui: {}, tarikhLalai: '', kembang: {}, butirBuka: {} };
let uidSlot = 0;

function renderAgihan() {

function muatAgihan(idPilih) {

function pilihJK(id) {
  A.idJk = id;
  A.slot = binaSlot(id);
  A.asal = {};
  A.data.lantikan.filter(l => l.id_jk === id).forEach(l => {
    A.asal[l.id_lantikan] = l.id_guru + '|' + l.id_jawatan + '|' + l.tarikh_kuat_kuasa + '|' + l.tarikh_tamat + '|' + (l.butiran || '');
  });
  A.amaranSlot = {};
  A.diakui = {};
  A.butirBuka = {};
  const kosongPertama = A.slot.find(s => !s.id_guru);
  A.slotAktif = kosongPertama ? kosongPertama.kunci : null;
}

function binaSlot(idJk) {
  const L = A.data.lantikan.filter(l => l.id_jk === idJk);
  const slot = [];
  const buat = (l, idJaw) => ({ kunci: ++uidSlot, id_lantikan: l ? l.id_lantikan : '', id_jawatan: idJaw, id_guru: l ? l.id_guru : '',
    tarikh_kuat_kuasa: l ? l.tarikh_kuat_kuasa : '', tarikh_tamat: l ? l.tarikh_tamat : '', butiran: l ? (l.butiran || '') : '' });
  // Slot kosong hanya untuk jawatan wajib; JK tanpa lantikan juga diberi slot asas. Jawatan lain melalui "Tambah Posisi".
  const asas = L.length ? [] : ['PENGERUSI', 'SETIAUSAHA', 'AJK'];
  const dikenal = {};
  (S.rujukan.jawatan || []).forEach(j => {
    dikenal[j.id_jawatan] = 1;
    const ada = L.filter(l => l.id_jawatan === j.id_jawatan)
      .sort(bandingButiran);
    ada.forEach(l => slot.push(buat(l, j.id_jawatan)));
    if (!ada.length && (j.wajib_setiap_jk === 'Y' || asas.indexOf(j.id_jawatan) !== -1)) slot.push(buat(null, j.id_jawatan));
  });
  L.filter(l => !dikenal[l.id_jawatan]).forEach(l => slot.push(buat(l, l.id_jawatan)));
  A.berunit = jkBerunit(L);
  if (A.berunit) {
    // Kekalkan susunan asal bagi yang setara (sort stabil)
    const asal = slot.map((x, i) => [x, i]);
    asal.sort((p, q) => bandingUnit(p[0], q[0]) || p[1] - q[1]);
    return asal.map(p => p[0]);
  }
  return slot;
}

/** Slot yang disimpan: ada guru, sudah wujud dalam Sheet, atau posisi tambahan (kosong pun disimpan). */
function slotDisimpan(s) { return !!(s.id_guru || s.id_lantikan || s.tambahan); }
function perubahanAgihan() {
  let n = 0;
  const ada = {};
  A.slot.forEach(s => {
    if (s.id_lantikan && A.asal[s.id_lantikan] !== undefined) {
      ada[s.id_lantikan] = 1;
      if (A.asal[s.id_lantikan] !== s.id_guru + '|' + s.id_jawatan + '|' + s.tarikh_kuat_kuasa + '|' + s.tarikh_tamat + '|' + String(s.butiran || '').trim()) n++;
    } else if (slotDisimpan(s)) n++;
  });
  Object.keys(A.asal).forEach(id => { if (!ada[id]) n++; });
  return n;
}
function agihanKotor() { return S.halaman === 'agihan' && A.data && A.idJk && perubahanAgihan() > 0; }
function sahkanTinggalAgihan() {

  return window.confirm('Terdapat perubahan lantikan yang belum disimpan. Tinggalkan tanpa menyimpan?');
}

function skorJawatan(idJaw, jk) {
  const j = (S.rujukan.jawatan || []).find(x => x.id_jawatan === idJaw);
  return pemberatTahap(jk.tahap) * (j ? Number(j.skor) : 0) * Number(jk.faktor_tempoh || 0);
}
function kiraIndeksKlien(g, T) {
  if (!g || g.dikecualikan || g.status === 'BERTUKAR_KELUAR' || !(Number(g.faktor) > 0)) return null;
  const t = A.data.tetapan, r = A.data.rujukan;
  const nm = r.M > 0 ? g.M / r.M : 0, nt = r.T > 0 ? T / r.T : 0;
  return (t.ALPHA * nm + (1 - t.ALPHA) * nt) / Number(g.faktor);
}
/** Skor tugas guru dengan mengambil kira draf jawatankuasa yang dipilih. */
function tEfektif(idGuru) {
  const g = A.guruMap[idGuru];
  if (!g) return 0;
  const jk = A.jkMap[A.idJk];
  let T = g.T;
  A.data.lantikan.forEach(l => { if (l.id_jk === A.idJk && l.id_guru === idGuru) T -= skorJawatan(l.id_jawatan, jk); });
  A.slot.forEach(s => { if (s.id_guru === idGuru) T += skorJawatan(s.id_jawatan, jk); });
  return T;
}
function amaranCalon(g, slot) {
  const am = [];
  const jaw = (S.rujukan.jawatan || []).find(j => j.id_jawatan === slot.id_jawatan) || {};
  if (g.tahap !== null && g.tahap !== undefined && jaw.tahap_gred_min_cadangan !== '' && jaw.tahap_gred_min_cadangan !== undefined &&
    Number(g.tahap) < Number(jaw.tahap_gred_min_cadangan)) am.push('W04');
  if (A.slot.some(s => s.kunci !== slot.kunci && s.id_guru === g.id_guru && String(s.butiran || '').trim() === String(slot.butiran || '').trim())) am.push('W06');
  if (g.status !== 'AKTIF' || !(Number(g.faktor) > 0)) am.push('W08');
  return am;
}
function wajibKosongDraf() {
  const wajib = (S.rujukan.jawatan || []).filter(j => j.wajib_setiap_jk === 'Y').map(j => j.id_jawatan);
  return wajib.filter(w => !A.slot.some(s => s.id_jawatan === w && s.id_guru));
}
